method: Independent numpy matrix construction of C*R_source_global*R_neutral_global^-1*C^-1 versus imported world pose*rest^-1 at four quarter-cycle baked keyframes. No translation/bone-length equivalence implied.

authored-walk-v2.reference_status: source reconstruction, not observed game state or exact runtime output

visual_review.observations: Jaw silhouette stays intact, no prior diagonal jaw opening. Limbs alternate coherently; fast clip uses larger bent-arm swing. Generated mitten/forearm proportion asymmetry remains. These four poses do not establish continuous absence of self-intersection or game likeness.

limits: Quarter-keyframe rotation agreement verifies the explicit retarget formula, not the correctness of reconstructed source neutral axes or anatomical correspondence.
Rigid shoes preserve shape but planar contact/slide is not established by this audit.
Principal point-cloud extent ratios quantify region shape change; they are not mesh-volume measurements. Upper-arm deformation persists with mixed weights.
Torso core mask has only one vertex under >0.7 aggregate Spine influence; no torso-only point-shape claim is made.
